artifacts.observation: The archive caveat reports 10 successful memory-pool trajectories whose task_description matches evaluation instances: 6 conductivity-unknown, 2 change-state, 2 grow-plant.

The fixed 50-task evaluation manifest contains exactly five conductivity-unknown rows, five change-state rows, and five grow-plant rows; it contains game_idx/task_name/role/human but not exact taskDescription text.

inference.statement: The reported 10 overlaps are trajectory-level matches, not 10 necessarily distinct evaluation rows. Because six conductivity-unknown training trajectories are reported as overlapping while the evaluation manifest has only five conductivity-unknown rows, at least two of those six trajectories must map to the same evaluation taskDescription if the archive counts and manifest refer to the same fixed evaluation set. Therefore a one-to-one 'remove 10 eval rows' correction is impossible. Under the reported family counts, the number of distinct affected evaluation rows is bounded between 3 and 9 until exact taskDescription multiplicities are recovered.
inference.scope: Bound applies only to the cited archived overlap counts and the cited fixed 50-task manifest at the pinned public commit. It does not identify which game_idx rows are affected and does not recompute any filtered significance.

phase1_assessment.reason: The static artifacts tighten the overlap correction semantics, but exact eval-row identity remains unavailable because the manifest lacks taskDescription and no row-level mapping was recovered in this bounded slice.
